turns.doctor_question: Hi, welcome in—I'm Dr. [Name]. To start, can you tell me what's been bringing you in today?
turns.patient_response:
Hi, Doctor. Well, what brings me in is that I've realized I keep arranging my own house around not seeing spiders. 

It's gotten to the point where I put off doing my laundry just because it's down in the basement, and I completely avoid the garden shed. I'm even paying people to come over and do small jobs that I know perfectly well how to do myself, just because I can’t make myself go into those spaces anymore.

symptom_reasoning.S064: The patient describes actively avoiding specific areas like the basement and garden shed and hiring others to do tasks to avoid encountering spiders.

turns.doctor_question: How long have you been dealing with this fear and avoidance of spiders—has it been going on for six months or more?
turns.patient_response: Yes, definitely longer than six months. It's been going on for about thirteen months now. It really started shortly after I moved into the house... I was unpacking some boxes and found those spiders, and I've just been dealing with it ever since.
